correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all six unordered effective bond states with three p-probability tree edges and three g-probability nonlocal edges. Conditional on occupied edge set E, uniform seed size-j probability equals (1/4)sum_components |C| 1{|C|=j}. The distinct star-minus-path coefficient table has six nonzero (k,l) entries at (0,2),(2,0),(1,1),(0,3),(2,1),(1,2). Their weighted sum is (1-p)(p-g)^2*(1,-4(1-g),3,-4g), divided by four. Multiplying by j,j^2,j^3 yields K(1-4g)/2, 3K(1-4g), K(25/2-56g). When 0<g,r<1, K=(1-g)^3(1-r)r^2>0; g=1/4 gives moment alias and third-moment gap -3K/2. Independent separate 64-configuration and 512-opportunity enumerations with exact rational parameters were read; independent_checks.py reconstructs the table and representative endpoints. Four sites are first with nonisomorphic local trees.
residual_risks: Exact statement is for undirected independent transmissible bonds and uniformly sampled seed; not general SIR with correlated outgoing transmissions or variable infectious periods.

Finite enumerations are exhaustive because the universe is exactly 2^6 effective bond states; numeric parameters alone would not prove the all-real-parameter polynomial identity, which follows by algebra.
